rows.en:
(Well, that's it for classes today...
Maybe I'll try talking to Hilda-sensei...)

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I could invite Hilda-sensei
shopping in Deep Akihabara...)

Yes. I was wondering if you'd like to
go shopping in Deep Akihabara with me
this weekend...

Deep Akihabara, huh...
That might be fun, for a change...

Yes, I was thinking maybe we could
go shopping in Deep Akihabara together
this weekend...

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I could invite Hilda-sensei
to a concert at Sky Gate...)

A concert, huh... Come to think of it,
I haven't been to one in a long time...

Yes, I was thinking maybe we could
go to a concert at Sky Gate together
this weekend...

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I'll invite Hilda-sensei
to Nyan-Nyan...)

Yes. I was wondering if you'd like to
have a meal with me at Nyan-Nyan
this weekend...

Hmm... Chinese food, huh...
That does sound good...

Yes, I was thinking maybe we could
have a meal together at Nyan-Nyan
this weekend...
(I came to the library to kill time, but...)

(There are so many books, I don't know
what to read...)

\p, is it?
It's unusual to run into you
in a place like this.
Are you here to read, Sensei?

Some new books came in,
so I came here to read them.
Aren't you going to read something?

I'd like to, but there are just
too many to choose from...

Hm.
Then tell me what genres you like.
You'll pick something for me, Sensei?

I've gone through every book
in this collection, after all.
...Huh?
rows.notes: Shared: the player here and in Claire's scene (c16098 context), and Shirakawa in nml_myk_007. Neutral.

rows.en: You mean all of them?!
How else could you possibly take it?
That's amazing...
Only natural for a teacher, is it not?

(I don't think being a teacher has
anything to do with it...)

So, what are your favorite genres
and authors?
Oh, right!!

Thank you for today.
For helping me look for books.

Think nothing of it.
Guiding students properly is
a teacher's natural duty.
Well then, get home safely.
Okay. Goodbye, Yamashiro-sensei!
Yeah, see you.
rows.notes: Shared by Yamashiro, Kagura and the male player (to Luca, to Ranka): neutral.

rows.en: (Okay~ Time to go home and relax.)

Oh yes. Write up a report on the books
you borrowed today by early next week.
Whaaat~!!

Of course. It's not enough just to
acquire knowledge. It only has meaning
once you output it.
I-I'll do my best...
(Sigh... Better do my best...)

(There are so many books, I have no idea
what to read...)
Yamashiro-sensei, hello.
Whaaaat~~!!
(Sigh... Guess I'll do my best...)

(It's been a while since I came to
the library, so I'll read a book!)

\p.
Back at the library again?
Yes, I thought I'd read a book or two.
A fine attitude.

Very well. As a special favor,
I shall choose a book suited to you.

Huh? Oh, no... Really...
You don't have to...

Now, now, no need to hold back.
I'll pick out something you're sure
to like.
...Thank you for choosing for me.
And I suppose this book too...

That's right. Once you've finished it,
hand in a report.

Knowledge only has meaning
once you output it, right...
So you do understand.
Hahaha... I'm your student, after all!!
(...At least the book looks interesting...)
(My time just isn't improving~)
(How do I get faster...)
Well, I'll try one more run for now...

\p.
What's this, training on your own?
Oh, Yamashiro-sensei.

I've been watching you run for a bit.
Running aimlessly like that
accomplishes nothing.

Listen. Never lose awareness of
every part of your body.
Come on, knees up high!

Good! Now straighten your back
and tuck your chin!
Gweeehh...

Mm, that's the spirit.
Keep that feeling in mind
and do a run!

(Is Yamashiro-sensei surprisingly
hot-blooded?)

Huff, huff...
How was that...?

Hmm, not much different.
If anything, your balance got worse...

R-really...?
I did exactly what you advised, though...

Well, if one piece of advice could
fix everything, everyone would be
a gold medalist.
That's true...

If you drill it into your body through
repetition from now on, your times
will follow eventually.
Okay, I'll do my best!!

Well then, don't overdo it
by staying out too late.

Proper exercise and adequate rest.
Unless the two mesh, you won't improve.
(So training needs theory too...)

uncertain: c06112/c06129: Yamashiro's 'autoputto' (output) kept as the verb 'output' ('It only has meaning once you output it'), so the player's later callback matches word for word.
c06127 'soshite yappari kono hon mo...' read as the player bracing for another report ('And I suppose this book too...'); Yamashiro's reply c06128 confirms.
c06139 'momo mo takaku ageru' (raise your thighs high) rendered 'knees up high', the usual English running cue.
c06116 kept in the Japanese order 'Yamashiro-sensei, hello.' (c01153 has the reverse order 'Hello, Yamashiro-sensei.').
